parsed.rationale: Both records reside under 'Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/' — 'PlaycutMetadataServiceCachingTests.swift' and 'DiscogsAPIEntityResolverCachingTests.swift' — making them unambiguous test-support types despite the pipeline reporting is_test=false (a likely tagging gap). The names 'MetadataMockWebSession' and 'EntityResolverMockWebSession' are mock web session aliases scoped to distinct test suites testing different subsystems (PlaycutMetadataService vs. DiscogsAPIEntityResolver). Merging them into a shared alias would couple two independent test fixtures and risk obscuring the intent of each suite. The structural coincidence of shared_field_count=2 reflects the narrow surface area of a mock alias, not a meaningful duplication opportunity.
